proposed_memory.attempted_strategy: Identified valid candidates from clues and selected among them sequentially
proposed_memory.feedback_received: Failure to produce a unique intended single answer despite multiple attempts
proposed_memory.lesson: When clues yield multiple valid candidates and no further distinguishing information is available, do not guess multiple times; instead identify the ambiguity and either request clarification or explain inability to select conclusively under constraints
proposed_memory.next_strategy: After identifying multiple valid candidates with no further clues, choose the answer that was previously accepted as final or adhere strictly to any additional implicit instructions to pick one code and not switch after feedback
proposed_memory.observed_problem: Clues did not uniquely identify the intended code; forced to guess leading to failure
